label: BREAK: compiled-route-guard.cjs stays all-fresh with exit 0 after sk-code-obsidian and sk-code-webflow are deleted — inspect() checks manifest freshness and authored/runtime bytes only, never packet directory existence, so a hub serving routes to deleted packets looks healthy.

BREAK: compiled-route.cjs --hub sk-code still returns packetId sk-code-obsidian for an obsidian prompt and sk-code-webflow for a webflow prompt after deletion (exit 0, same effectivePolicyHash 8cd6f489…, generation 2 as control); opencode and generic prompts return sk-code-opencode. No output marks the packet as missing on disk.

BREAK: parent-skill-check.cjs on sk-code exits 1 with 113 invariant failures: 3c x2 (packet is not an existing sub-directory), 5d x1 (sk-code-webflow/SKILL.md, sk-code-obsidian/SKILL.md missing), 10a-manifest-source x1 (MODE_LEAF_SET_COLLISION — both deleted modes get hash-equal empty leaf sets 4f53cda18c2b), 12a-router-contract x109 (RRC-006 resource paths do not resolve).

OK: the 5k canary legs stay green through the deletion — PASS 5k-alias, 5k-packet and 5k-canary all pass because routerSignals and the canary fixture still describe the deleted packets; contradicts iteration 3's inference that a deletion fails 5k-canary.

BREAK: the doctor's fleet root-metadata/package gate fails after deletion — ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs exits 1, checked=14 passed=13 failed=1, sk-code the only failure on RRC-006 resource path sk-code-obsidian/references/comment-grammar.md (intent OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN).
OK: parent-skill-check-invariants.test.cjs passes 98/98 with exit 0 after deletion — it validates the checker against fixtures, not the live hub, so it cannot catch a live deletion.

OK: skill-advisor advisor_recommend survives the deletion and routes a code prompt to sk-code (score 0.708, confidence 0.90, compiledRoute -> sk-code-opencode, exit 0); the advisor carries no surface ids, so deletion is invisible to it.

PRESENCE: compiled-route-sync.cjs cannot complete without specs/ content — ENOENT lstat specs at line 39 kills even --help; with an empty specs dir the no-arg build exits 1 with 'SYNC FAILED: authored resolver missing at specs/sk-doc/z_archive/019-skill-routing-refactor/015-router-unification-program/014-runtime-engine/lib/resolve.cjs'. Deletion-attribution unproven; what would settle it: a copy including specs/, control and treatment.

OK: the compiled-route test suite runs 7/8 pass after deletion; the single failure (compiled-route-manifest.test.cjs, authored resolver missing under specs/) is a specs-exclusion artifact — the control run after git checkout restore fails identically.

A hub can serve routes to deleted packets while every gate that reports on it says fresh/OK: the guard reports fresh, the front door returns dangling packet ids with exit 0, and the 5k canary leg passes. Only the structural doctor legs (3c, 5d, 10a, 12a) and the fleet package gate fail.
